[SWS_DM_00055] Supported event memories
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04214, RS_Diag_04150, RS_Diag_04058
⌈
The DM shall support the
•
primary event memory
• up to 256
user-defined event memories
according to ISO 14229-1[1].
⌋
Note: From DM perspective the primary and user defined fault memories are all in-
stances of a database. Each instance is treated in exactly the same way.
